messages:
anna_sales: Heads-up: BrightPay wants a short evaluation but requires strict EU geolock. No US subprocessors, BYO-KMS, tenant-level pinning, and a signed routing clause. Need a single artifact pack for procurement by Thu.

matt_sre: We can pin to eu-west-1, eu-central-1, and eu-west-3. Storage choices are EU-only buckets. Monitoring runs on Datadog EU tenancy but support access details pending  will request vendor attestation. I'll add tiny perf numbers for each region.

zara_se: BYO-KMS supported for Dedicated and Private. Flow: customer provides KMS ARN + cross-account role; we envelope-encrypt and never import keys. Note: BYO-KMS kicks compliance review (~7 business days). Drafting runbook + sample curl/IAM trust now.

kevin_presales: Pricing: geo-pin add-on +11% for a 30d trial; strict no-global-fallback (full EU isolation) +21% due to reserved capacity. We can propose a one-time promo to waive geo-pin if they convert to Dedicated within 45 days (needs RevOps ok). Preparing two quotes.

procure_bot: PROC-998 created: Requesting Datadog EU support attestation and subprocessor addendum. ETA 4 business days. Link: https://intra.redwood/proc/998

ivana_legal: If BrightPay requires "no non-EU human access" to telemetry we need a contractual addendum and a technical plan (VPC telemetry proxy or Private). Recommend clarifying acceptable mitigations.

anna_sales: Action items: 1) @matt_sre finalize region matrix + perf notes, 2) @zara_se publish BYO-KMS runbook + IAM sample, 3) @kevin_presales share two quote variants and promo language, 4) @ivana_legal & @procure_bot chase Datadog attestation. Need package by Thu COB.

matt_sre: Routing snippet for procurement to review: {"pin_tenant":true,"primary":"EU","standby":"EU","global_fallback":false,"consent_required":true}

zara_se: Runbook draft uploaded to shared drive; will paste cURL snippet into thread in 30m.

kevin_presales: Draft quotes in progress, will post in-thread when ready.
